answer: Because the timing is recorded against the spiral challenge, the lotus audit can replay the pulse history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 123 submissions and hold each member open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 2078 identities would post 2246 proofs and burn roughly 24 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
